The '''Death Altar''' is a [[runic altar]] upon which [[death rune]]s are crafted from [[pure essence]], providing 10 [[Runecraft]] [[experience]] per essence imbued. Level 65 [[Runecraft]] and completion of the [[quest]] [[Mourning's End Part II]] are required to craft death runes.

Players may create a [[death tiara]] here by using either a [[death talisman]] or a [[tiara]] on the altar whilst having both in their inventory, granting 50 [[Runecraft]] [[experience]]. A [[catalytic tiara]] can also be created here by using a [[catalytic talisman]] and [[gold tiara]], granting 42.5 Runecraft experience.

Upon entering the Death Altar, the [[music]] track [[La Mort]] plays.

==Transportation==
{{Map|name=Death Altar|align=left|mtype=pin|x = 1859|y = 4638|mapID = -1|height = 275|width = 275|caption = The location of the mysterious ruins used to enter the Death Altar.}}
The entrance to the altar can be found on the bottom level of the [[Temple of Light]]. After completion of [[Mourning's End Part II]], the altar can also be accessed through the [[Abyss]].

To enter the [[Mysterious ruins#Death|mysterious ruins]], players either have to use a [[death talisman]] on the ruins, or click "Enter" on the ruins while wearing a [[death tiara]]. Alternatively, a [[catalytic talisman]] or [[catalytic tiara|tiara]] can be used.

As the altar is one of the least-accessible in terms of distance from a bank, it's recommended to use the [[Abyss]] in order to craft a large amount of runes.

Additionally, the altar can be accessed via the  Guardians of the Rift minigame. This can be a useful shortcut if wanting to access the altar quickly while avoiding the wilderness.

===The Ruins===
Entering the ruins by walking requires entering the [[Temple of Light]] with a [[crystal trinket]] and using the following directions.

#Go up the stairs at the main entrance.
#Go south and up the staircase.
#Go to the centre of the temple.
#Climb down the next stairs twice.
#Rotate the mirror by selecting search on the pillar of light, to open the light door.
''Note'': When leaving, remember to rotate the mirror again for future visits.

===The Underground Pass===
Alternatively, the Death Altar can be entered from the dwarven camp in the [[Underground Pass (dungeon)|Underground Pass]]. This is also a way to enter this area if you have forgotten to rotate the mirror when exiting through the ruins. The run takes around 2 minutes and doesn't require a Crystal trinket, but does require partial completion of Mourning's End Part II.

#Make your way to the western entrance to the Underground Pass. (Teleport to Lletya or Prifddinas.)
#Go down the well.
#Make your way to the lower level (either by falling on a jump or by making it to the stairs at the southern end of the map).
#Go to the dwarf camp in the south-west corner of the map.
#Descend the cave in the south-west corner of the dwarf camp.

==Trivia==
*The main music, [[La Mort]], is French for "Death".
*The ability to sell [[cat]]s to the citizens of [[West Ardougne]] for death runes foreshadowed that the Death Altar is located near West Ardougne.
*The area existed in-game alongside all other Runic altars when the skill was launched, but not made accessible until 2005.
